Question ID: BIO_U03_L01_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.BIO.ENE.01

Assessment focus: Use the embedded Unit 3 stimulus exactly as written.

Water PropertyEvidenceLife Process Supported
PolarityDissolves many charged substancesTransport in cells and blood
CohesionWater molecules stick togetherWater movement in plants

Why does water's polarity support transport in living things?

answer.text: Polarity prevents all substances from dissolving.

feedback.text: This choice does not use the included stimulus. Recheck the table, model, or scenario and connect the answer to the lesson standard.

answer.text: Cohesion means water cannot move in plants.

feedback.text: This choice confuses the mapped Unit 3 vocabulary or process. Recheck the table, model, or scenario and connect the answer to the lesson standard.

answer.text: Water properties are unrelated to cell transport.

feedback.text: This choice overstates or misreads the evidence. Recheck the table, model, or scenario and connect the answer to the lesson standard.

answer.text: Polarity helps water dissolve and carry many substances.

feedback.text: Polarity explains why water can dissolve many materials needed for biological transport. This matches the mapped Unit 3 lesson content and uses the included stimulus.
